svg.title: San Juan study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: San Juan; 2: Barreal; 3: San José de Jáchal; 4: Iglesia; 5: Villa Mercedes; 6: Tamberías; 7: Rodeo

g.title: 3 · San José de Jáchal: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
